**The native build of 1.4.3.** It's the same code as 1.4.3, published so panels on the **Native** channel get the new help too. The Rust system helper hasn't changed since 1.4.2-native.1.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.4.3-native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS.
